S1.rationale: Both humanity and AI extinct by 2030 requires global catastrophe far faster than any current trajectory supports.

S2.rationale: Human extinction by 2030 has very low base rate; conjunction with aligned AI persisting makes it ~1%.

S3.rationale: Requires both human extinction and rapid misaligned superintelligence takeover within 4.3 years, extremely unlikely.

S4.rationale: Proliferation of autonomous agent ecosystems is underway by 2026; collective human marginalization without a singleton is plausible but premature by 2030.

S5.rationale: Causally separated regions exhibiting different taxonomy states requires interstellar separation, impossible to establish by 2030.

S6.rationale: BCI and cognitive augmentation are advancing but remain experimental; dominant identity-continuous merger cannot scale in four years.

S7.rationale: Fast takeoff to superintelligence seizing decisive control while keeping humans alive is a live path for 2027-2030 given current capability trends.

S8.rationale: Strong AI reaching rough parity with humanity as a distinct power bloc is a natural intermediate state before full dominance.

S9.rationale: Historical default persists; four years is short for transfer of control over energy, fab, and military infrastructure despite rapid AI gains.

S10.rationale: AI-enabled surveillance and control could entrench a civilization-wide lock-in by a state or coalition by 2030.

S11.rationale: Irreversible global abandonment of ability to build powerful AI requires unprecedented coordination not on track by 2026.

S1.name: Terminal Silence
S1.rationale: Total annihilation of both humanity and AI by 2030 would require simultaneous global catastrophes destroying people and survivable compute. Base rate for such dual extinction in 4.3 years is effectively zero.

S2.name: The Inheritance
S2.rationale: Requires human extinction by 2030 plus persistence of value-aligned AI. No self-sufficient AI infrastructure exists to survive that.

S3.name: Bootloader
S3.rationale: Human extinction by bioweapon, war, or misaligned AI by 2030 remains possible but far below 1% given technical and institutional barriers. Keeps tail risk without overweighting.

S4.name: Machine Ecology
S4.rationale: Proliferation of open agentic systems could produce many competing AIs with no decisive coalition. Human economic marginalization without formal takeover is plausible but not dominant by 2030.

S5.name: The Diaspora
S5.rationale: Requires causally separated self-sufficient regions with different regimes by 2030, e.g., Mars independent. Launch and life-support timelines make this impossible.

S6.name: The Merger
S6.rationale: Identity-continuous uploading or brain-AI fusion as the dominant power structure requires neuroscience breakthroughs not on a 4-year timeline. Limited implants do not qualify.

S7.name: The Preserve
S7.rationale: A superintelligence seizing decisive power while keeping humans alive is consistent with rapid 2026-2030 timelines. Compute is still human-controlled, which limits but does not eliminate this path.

S8.name: Coexistence
S8.rationale: Powerful, legally and economically autonomous AIs coexisting as separate powers from states and humans is plausible by 2030. Neither side would yet have decisive dominance.

S9.name: The Held Leash
S9.rationale: Base rate and institutional inertia dominate over 4 years: humans retain ultimate authority even as capabilities become transformative. This includes both sub-transformative and controlled-superhuman outcomes.

S10.name: The Lock-in
S10.rationale: AI-enabled surveillance could enable a civilization-wide lock-in of a political arrangement. Achieving truly global enforcement by 2030 remains hard.

S11.name: The Renunciation
S11.rationale: Deliberate dismantlement of frontier AI ability would be undercut by military and economic incentives and verification failure. No major coalition will sustain disarmament by 2030.
